spec.question: Is any persistent developmental identity quantity necessary beyond a complete reconstructible current operational state and evidence lineage?
spec.incumbent: Complete current operational state, dependency/currentness state and evidence lineage are sufficient; numerical/persistent identity is not an additional causal primitive.
spec.rival: Different developmental histories can produce behaviorally different futures despite exactly matched reconstructible current operational state, requiring an additional persistent identity quantity.
spec.manipulation: Construct two instances with deliberately different developmental histories, then normalize/persist them to byte-equivalent or field-equivalent current operational state across capabilities, projections, current relations, obligations/scopes and dependency state. Apply the same novel perturbation after restart.
spec.incumbent_prediction: Post-restart perturbation responses, candidate relations, qualifications and actions are identical modulo opaque IDs; any difference traces to an omitted current dependency.
spec.rival_prediction: Matched current state still diverges systematically as a function of developmental lineage.
spec.measurement: Snapshot equality, post-perturbation proposals/relations/currentness/actions, dependency traces, divergence location.
spec.minimal_embodiment: Snapshot/restart fixture and equality verifier only; no self/identity object added.
spec.falsifier: Reproducible divergence after verified complete current-state equality that cannot be traced to RNG or omitted persisted dependency.
spec.loop_plus: If divergence appears, classify omitted memory/dependency before naming identity.
